description: Whitespace-radar pool: which ecosystem artifacts count as evidence of prior work. Paths are relative to the repo root; every source is data, never code. exclude_globs drops artifacts that quote the radar's own benchmark topics, which would otherwise let the radar find evidence it manufactured itself.
snapshot_note: module_manifest.json is a point-in-time snapshot of the capability surface (repo digests are inside it). Refresh with: python3 tools/whitespace_radar.py --build-manifest --repo TensorPlatform=. --include backend/ --include tools/ --include src/ --include api/ --include harness_gateway/ --include quality/ ; a refresh changes pool_digest, so re-run --bench --calibrate before merging.
